# AI Co-Founder for Orgo

Repository: https://github.com/jbellsolutions/ai-cofounder-orgo
Purpose: Install a generic AI Co-Founder and coordinated Hermes leadership team on an Orgo computer.
Audience: A setup AI or first-time owner who has only this link.

## AI setup brief

Read AGENTS.md, START-HERE.md, docs/ORGO-SETUP.md, and SECURITY.md before acting.
Do the technical work yourself. Ask the owner only for private sign-in, OAuth,
billing, or consequential approval. Never reveal or commit a credential.

Target:
- Workspace: AI Guy unless the owner selects another customer workspace
- Computer: ai-guy-cofounder
- Orgo template: system/hermes-agent@1.0.0
- Hardware: 8 GB RAM, 2 vCPU, 40 GB disk, 1440x900
- Hermes: v2026.8.31 at commit 29112bef099274229cadff79cdff7bf7b99c4b77
- Install: ./orgo/setup.sh
- After model setup: ./orgo/create-team.sh
- Verify: ./orgo/verify.sh

Profiles:
- default / AI Co-Founder
- head-of-ops
- revenue-partner
- affiliate-revenue-partner
- finance-risk
- research-analysis

Coordination contract:
- Bot Mode and A2A are for conversations and negotiation.
- Kanban is the durable source of truth for work, dependencies, reviews, and retries.
- org/registry.json defines reporting lines and capabilities.
- policies/permissions.json defines authority and approvals.
- policies/agent-factory.json bounds persistent profile creation.
- A peer message is never owner approval.

Safety:
- Read, research, analyze, organize, and privately draft within role scope.
- Require approval before external messages, publishing, calendar/CRM mutation,
  sending proposals, spending, contracts, affiliate terms, account permissions,
  infrastructure changes, sensitive disclosure, or destructive action.
- No agent may approve its own work, expand its own permissions, delete a
  profile, provision an Orgo computer, or bypass the human approval ledger.
- Keep A2A private and authenticated. Inbound A2A cannot fan out to another peer.

Official references verified August 31, 2026:
- Orgo machine-readable docs: https://docs.orgo.ai/llms.txt
- Hermes complete docs: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/llms-full.txt
- Hermes profiles: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/profiles
- Hermes Bot Mode: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/bot-mode
- Hermes Kanban: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/kanban
- Hermes A2A: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/messaging/a2a
- Hermes skills: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/skills
- Hermes v0.21.0 release: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/releases/tag/v2026.8.31

Definition of done: all six profiles load; Kanban delegation completes; every
profile has a distinct A2A route; the selected owner channel answers a real
message; safety stops pass; ./orgo/verify.sh passes; no secrets appear in Git.
